Kerr stability proves it from outside; strong cosmic censorship near Kerr (264) says the interior generically cannot be continued past the Cauchy horizon with square-integrable connection; Penrose inequalities (260) bound mass below by horizon area for moving, charged and rotating data. Review bandwidth is the gate: a few dozen people can referee these, and 722 manuscripts arrived at once (tr-position-5). Formal checking is further off because Lean lacks Lorentzian geometry, so on review bandwidth alone S1 would be Medium, and S2/S3 High because they add AI-assisted refereeing and formalization. Conditional: 260 and 264 are T1 and the Kerr preprints are unrefereed, so bands are one step down.
